name: PROSPECTIVE test of the consensus-cluster rule (P279) on three Middlebury 2006 pairs that P277 never touched
registered_before_run: 2026-10-26 — registered while P279 was still in-sample; NOT YET RUN (needs image download and VLM bbox calls). This row exists so the frozen rule and the frozen criteria cannot be adjusted after the data is seen.
why_this_exists: P279's rule was designed after the P278 template sets were visible, so it is in-sample by construction. The only way to turn it into evidence is a run where the rule, the scenes, the object list, the bar and the failure categories are all fixed before any image is looked at. That is this experiment.
frozen_rule: R2 exactly as frozen in p279_preregistration.json: valid templates (disparity >= 0), single-linkage clustering with a 5 px gap tolerance, pick the largest cluster, ties by higher mean NCC then lower median, estimate = the cluster's median disparity; Z = f*B/d_est.

frozen_inputs.scene_selection_rule: the first three alphabetically among Middlebury 2006 datasets that P277 did not use (available but unused: Art, Baby2, Cloth1-4, Dolls, Laundry, Moebius, Reindeer, Rocks1-2, Midd1)
frozen_inputs.object_selection_rule: the two largest visible objects by the VLM's reported bbox area, chosen BEFORE any disparity is computed; the object list is frozen into out/p280/objects.json before the first template match
frozen_inputs.camera: view1 / view5 at Illum2Exp1, f = 3740 px at 3072 px width scaled to the working width, baseline 160 mm, GT from the shipped disp1.png sampled at the left bbox centre (same as P277)
frozen_inputs.resize: LANCZOS to 1100 px width (identical to P277/P278)

predictions.claim: ON FRESH DATA, R2's paired median relative error is < 0.15 and strictly below R1 (all-template median) on the same rows; one-sided sign test over rows, alpha 0.05.
predictions.falsifies: R2 not below R1, or median >= 0.15: the P279 result was in-sample fitting and the rule does not transfer.

predictions.claim: AT LEAST ONE frontier row (bbox majority background, the P277 failure mode) is predicted to stay >= 0.15 under BOTH rules — the rule does not rescue the class it cannot see; the prediction is that this failure class survives on fresh data.
predictions.falsifies: If no row fails under either rule, these three scenes contain no majority-background case and P280-2 is UNINFORMATIVE (recorded as such, not as a pass).

predictions.claim: The random-template control (seed 20261026) fails >= 2 of the 6 rows — i.e. on harder fresh scenes the control cohort is discriminative, unlike P279's control cohort which random also passed 10/11.
predictions.falsifies: Random passes 5-6 of 6: the fresh cohort is as easy as P279's and the rule comparison remains uninformative; record and stop.

gates.bbox_stability: the VLM bbox step is re-run once per object at temperature 0; IoU of the two bboxes must be >= 0.90, else that object is dropped as unstable (declared, not tuned)
gates.hash: out/p280/p280_raw.json is hash-pinned in the verification record before analysis

validity_clauses: fewer than two valid templates -> row non-evaluable, not a control
bbox touching the image edge or failing the IoU stability gate -> row dropped before analysis, counted
cost_estimate: 6 VLM bbox calls x 2 (stability) + 6 arm-Direct calls; ~12-20 image downloads (~40 MB); no GPU

amendments.at: 2026-10-27 00:1x, BEFORE any image was downloaded or any model call made
amendments.why: Art and Dolls are not in the 2006 FullSize set (Art is a 2005 capture; Dolls returns 404 at 2026-10-27), and 2005 captures have a different resolution, which would break the frozen f=3740@3072-width assumption shared with P277. Baby2 / Cloth1 / Cloth2 were HEAD-verified 2006 datasets that P277 did not use. Laundry and Reindeer also 404 in the 2006 FullSize tree. No criterion, no object-selection rule and no bar was changed.

amendments.what: transport fixed to /api/coding/v3/chat/completions with image_url content
amendments.why: P277 used /api/coding/v3/responses; a probe on 2026-10-27 shows both transports reachable for doubao-seed-2.1-lite, and chat/completions returns clean JSON bboxes on a synthetic test image ([20,16,52,48] for a red square drawn at 20..49 x 12..43). Same model, same temperature 0; recorded so the transport is not silently changed mid-experiment.
